    How DPS is calculated · Game mechanics

    The tower JSON is the source of truth for every upgrade's stats, damage components, descriptions and special mechanics. Stats and cooldowns are authored in GAME seconds. The calculator converts them to real-time DPS using the selected x1 / x2 / x3 game clock.

    1. Game clock and attack rate

    Clock scale = 0.375 × game speed (x1 = 0.375, x2 = 0.75, x3 = 1.125). DPS per real second = DPS per game second × clock scale. FireRate is the number of GAME seconds between attacks; attack rate = 1 / FireRate. Cooldowns and durations in the UI are converted to real seconds by dividing game seconds by the clock scale.

    2. Damage components and full DPS

    Each tower upgrade is calculated from its individual components: direct/projectile hit, pulse, cleave, line, splash, rain, boomerang, minions, traps and other authored effects. The main displayed DPS is the sum of confirmed and inferred additive components that hit one primary target. Components that hit further enemies are shown separately per additional enemy; they are not multiplied by an invented enemy count.

    3. Poison, burn and damage over time

    Poison/burn ticks every 0.5 GAME seconds. Sustained DoT per target = (damage per tick / 0.5) × min(1, duration / FireRate). The source method assumes DoT does not stack and uses full uptime when duration covers the attack interval. DoT is displayed as its own DPS component and is included in the total where the source confirms it.

    4. Burst, overheat and periodic attacks

    For burst towers with an overheat pause, sustained DPS = (BurstSize × Damage) / (BurstSize × FireRate + OverheatTime). This corrects the PDF's continuous-fire overestimate for Corn and Sweet Potato Casserole. Every-Nth empowered attacks are averaged over their cycle only when the special attack replaces a normal attack; extra or conditional attacks are kept distinct.

    5. Unit level, stars, shiny and traits

    Unit level multiplier = 1 + 0.008 × (level − 1), up to 1.392 at level 50. Stars add 5% damage per star. Shiny adds 10% attack speed. Trait damage, attack speed, crit/streak and boss bonuses are applied to DPS according to the selected trait. Jumbo changes range, not direct DPS.

    6. Support auras and timed abilities

    Only the strongest aura of each type (damage, attack speed, range) applies; equal-type auras do not stack. Supports and Fortune cannot be boosted by auras. Hot Chili Shake! is one paired window: 1.4× damage and 1.4× attack speed for 4s every 15s; average DPS uses the combined 1.96× active multiplier and uptime, not two separate averages. Staggered copies can extend coverage. Frankenstein Apple's 1.6× Overcharge affects itself for 4s every 16–18s. Its +30% range ability is a separate active buff for 10s every 40s (7.5% average range from one placement), never a passive permanent range aura.

    7. Area damage, bosses and flyers

    For one target, add only damage components that can hit that target. Pierce, line and area damage to each further enemy are shown as per-additional-enemy values. BossDamageMultiplier and AirDamageMultiplier apply when the selected target mode supports them. Crowd control (slow, stun, knockback, hypnosis and send-to-start) is not direct DPS and is not fabricated into the damage total.

    8. Uncertain, alternative and conditional effects

    Alternative attacks replace the normal attack and are not added on top. Conditional effects require their documented partner or condition. Assumption-level components and mechanics without enough source data are displayed as not included, rather than silently guessed. Fortune/Candy Box outcomes and other unquantified effects are not invented.

    9. Team totals and buff modes

    Without Buff excludes support effects. With Buff uses supports in the current player's loadout. With all team buffs uses support towers from all four players. Each tower's card and detail view use the same calculation engine; the detail view exposes the component DPS and the same live speed, level, quantity, trait and buff multipliers.

    Source: supplied Snack Defense tower JSON and its general_game_mechanics / dps_mechanics definitions. The PDF baseline is retained for comparison where it differs from the independently audited single-target component total. Fan-made tool; not affiliated with the game's developers.
